quiz.q: Why did Karl Marx describe the socialism of thinkers like Saint-Simon and Robert Owen as utopian?
options: Because they sought peaceful change by appealing to the moral conscience of capitalists rather than class struggle
Because they completely rejected social and economic equality in favor of competitive industrial capitalism
Because they organized violent proletarian revolutions without establishing any cooperative economic institutions
Because they advocated creating a stateless, classless society through immediate parliamentary legislation
quiz.why: Marx argued that early socialists lacked a scientific understanding of capitalism and naively relied on moral appeals instead of revolutionary action.

quiz.q: What did Karl Marx mean by asserting that he turned Hegel's dialectic right side up?
options: He rejected historical dialectics entirely, arguing that human societies remain fundamentally static over time
He maintained that material conditions drive reality, whereas Hegel viewed ideas as the moving force
He proved that religious consciousness serves as the ultimate foundation for all economic transformations
He argued that intellectual consensus among philosophers is necessary before any social change can occur
quiz.why: Marx argued that physical matter and economic relations shape historical reality, inverting Hegel's belief that history is driven by ideas.

quiz.q: According to Hegel, how does the state resolve the dialectical contradiction between family and civil society?
options: By eliminating all ethical bonds to allow unconstrained economic competition among individuals
By abolishing universal civic laws in order to restore particularistic family attachments
By synthesizing the altruism of the family with the universal scope of civil society
By dissolving private property and civic institutions into an unorganized, stateless community
quiz.why: The state synthesizes family altruism with civil society's universal sphere, resulting in universal altruism as the end of history.

quiz.q: How does the intellectual focus of the 'Young Marx' differ from that of the 'Mature Marx'?
options: Young Marx focused on establishing the welfare state, while Mature Marx supported unregulated market competition
Young Marx advocated immediate armed insurrection, while Mature Marx retreated into pure academic philosophy
Young Marx rejected Hegelian philosophy, while Mature Marx abandoned British political economy and historical materialism
Young Marx examined human alienation and freedom, while Mature Marx presented a revolutionary political programme
quiz.why: Young Marx wrote as a philosopher investigating alienation in his early manuscripts, whereas Mature Marx authored the Communist Manifesto as a practical political programme.
